meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 把 rtk 装到主机并只读挂载进容器，再给 agent 的 settings.json 加 PreToolUse hook，之后每次 Bash 命令都自动经 rtk 过滤。git、cargo、pytest 等常见开发命令可省 60–90% token，无需写 CLAUDE.md 指令。
howto.when: 当你需要给某个 agent 组的容器装上 rtk 时使用。需先用 groups list 拿到组 ID，再按组执行挂载、写 hook 等步骤。

say.text: 给 ag-xxx 这个组装上 rtk，容器里也要能用。
say.note: 会装二进制、加只读挂载并写入 hook。

say.text: 帮我确认这个组的 Bash 命令是不是已经走 rtk 了。
say.note: 会检查挂载和 settings.json 里的 hook。

say.text: 看看 rtk 到底省了多少 token。
say.note: 会运行 rtk gain 显示节省量。

howto.what_en: Installs rtk on the host, mounts it read-only into the container, and adds a PreToolUse hook to the agent's settings.json so every Bash call is filtered through rtk — 60–90% token savings on git, cargo, pytest, no CLAUDE.md needed.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to install rtk into an agent group's container. First list groups to get the ID, then repeat the mount and hook steps per group.

say_en.text: Install rtk into group ag-xxx and make it usable inside the container.
say_en.note: Installs the binary, adds a read-only mount, writes the hook.

say_en.text: Check whether this group's Bash calls already go through rtk.
say_en.note: Verifies the mount and the settings.json hook.

say_en.text: Show me how many tokens rtk has saved.
